rows.purpose_short: REGID-004 planning-only policy-context contract for passkey auth state, authenticator assurance, syncable-passkey AAL ceiling, proofing/CDD/EDD, screening freshness, consent, residency, retention, purpose, risk, and PDP/audit obligations without claiming WebAuthn itself satisfies KYC.

verification.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
root=pathlib.Path('specs')
contract=json.load(open(root/'passkey-kyc-policy-context-contract.json'))
assert contract['_meta']['kanban_task']=='t_0d6973c9'
required=set(contract['context_schema']['required'])
nested_required={k:set(v.get('required', [])) for k,v in contract['context_schema']['properties'].items()}
for rel in contract['representative_fixtures']:
    fx=json.load(open(rel))
    ctx=fx['context']
    assert required <= set(ctx), (rel, sorted(required-set(ctx)))
    for key, req in nested_required.items():
        if req:
            assert req <= set(ctx[key]), (rel, key, sorted(req-set(ctx[key])))
    assert set(fx['expected_obligations']) == set(ctx['pdp_audit_state']['obligations_required']), rel
    auth=ctx['auth_state']
    assert auth['webauthn_level_floor']=='WebAuthn-Level-3'
    assert not (auth['credential_type']=='syncable_passkey' and auth['syncable_passkey_aal_ceiling']!='AAL2')
    approval=auth['critical_operation_approval']
    if auth['acr']=='critical' or ctx['action_slug']=='compliance.accreditation-packet.publish':
        assert auth['authenticator_assurance']['device_binding']=='hardware_bound', rel
        assert auth['authenticator_assurance']['fido_mds_level'] in {'L2','L3'}, rel
        assert approval['required'] and approval['approval_ref'] and approval['approval_window_state']=='approved_in_window', rel
    else:
        assert approval['approval_window_state'] in {'not_required','missing','expired','denied','approved_in_window'}, rel
    assert not (fx['expected_decision']=='allow' and ctx['screening_state']['freshness_state']!='fresh')
PY
